comments: The text of the rTsod rigs bsdus don is found on 1b1-6b2 (p. 24). It is followed by two additions. The first is a versified list invoking 24 points of defeat (ltag chod) rather than 10. The second is a verse stating a logical observation.
alternative_names:
rtsod pa rig pa'i bsdus don (cover page)
rtsod pa'i rigs pa dam pa'i bsdus don (colophon verse)
name: rtsod pa rigs pa'i bsdus don (1)
item_description:
Script: 'bru tsha.
Proofread.
Double numbering of folios, from 1 to 7, and from 527 to 533 (hundred being represented by "x").
Lemmata written as interlinear notes.
